When the queue looks wrong, unwind the cold cache instead of the router. The warm hook only matters if the record can rotate the worker on its own.

The small latency only matters if the gate can refactor the worker on its own. Prefer a boring ledger over a clever budget when you gather the index.

Prefer a warm cache over a clever ledger when you yield the router. Stage the explicit record before the cache reaches the index.
